differential.name: Major depressive disorder
differential.rationale: Chronic stress, social isolation, limited social contact, and obesity are classic risk factors and common in mid‑life adults with depressive symptoms.

differential.name: Generalized anxiety disorder
differential.rationale: Persistent stress and risk‑activity involvement without clear focal stressor suggest a generalized anxiety picture.

differential.name: Prediabetes / Metabolic syndrome
differential.rationale: HbA1c 6.1 %, BMI 28.3 kg/m², dyslipidemia (elevated triglycerides) meet criteria for metabolic syndrome and prediabetes.

differential.name: Fibromyalgia (chronic pain syndrome)
differential.rationale: Reported chronic pain in a middle‑aged patient with sleep‑disturbing stress and psychosocial factors is typical for fibromyalgia.

differential.name: Chronic periodontitis (gingivitis progression)
differential.rationale: Gingivitis in the setting of prediabetes and poor oral hygiene is common and may reflect underlying systemic inflammation.
